narration_excerpt: If a work-from-home job pays you to inspect and reship packages, stop before you sign anything.
visual_action: Overhead desk shot: hand pauses holding blank shipping label over plain brown cardboard box next to generic remote job card on laptop.

narration_excerpt: The listing looks routine... legitimate retailers don't run shipping hubs through a stranger's home address.
visual_action: Generic clean UI job-post graphic highlighting 'Work From Home • Inspect & Forward Boxes', then red highlight underlines 'home address'.

narration_excerpt: In a reshipping scam, criminals typically buy goods with stolen payment details... putting your name and home address on the shipping trail while they stay hidden.
visual_action: Simple defensive 2D route diagram (no operational tactics): Stolen Payment -> Your Home Address -> Forwarded Box, highlighting the home address left on record.

narration_excerpt: When payday hits, the paycheck bounces or never arrives—leaving you facing fraud investigators or postal inspectors.
visual_action: Generic payroll notification flips to 'Unpaid / Returned' next to a plain stylized official inquiry envelope (no trademarked seals).

narration_excerpt: Never accept a remote job routing packages through your house, verify employers through their official website, and report suspicious offers to official consumer-protection or postal authorities.
